title: Vehicle control and recovery
robloxStudio: 0.746.0.7461269 observed on authoring workstation; recheck on replay
scenario: A player drives a small server-owned hover cart through a marked loop. Input is a bounded throttle/steer intent; the server simulates motion, checks route progress, and safely recovers an overturned or stuck cart.
expectedOutcomes: Input stays within throttle/steering bounds and request-rate limits.
The server owns vehicle simulation and route progress.
An off-course cart returns to a known safe start.
failureCases: Vehicle makes no progress for the configured recovery interval.
